limitations: No native dynamics, contact or new control/teacher execution
Linear optimizer termination does not establish exact twist feasibility or functional task success
Instantaneous Jacobian map is local; finite IK displacement and actual tracking dynamics differ
Cache decomposition alone cannot establish a global IK branch switch or unique cause
Velocity limits are external diagnostic references; original five physics gates and all F statuses unchanged

interpretation.first_feedback: Both first feedback states have low original finite-displacement mapping errors and a near-zero bounded-fit twist residual. This is a local baseline, not a full-trajectory test.
interpretation.UR_peak: The elbow desired -7.9573 rad/s combines both a new-IK-minus-prior-cache increment and an existing prior-cache-minus-actual gap; neither alone explains it. The saved solver accepted the finite pose with 0.0874 mm / 0.00304 rad residual. The weighted local Jacobian is less well conditioned than at first feedback; bounded rates leave a nonzero angular mapping residual.
interpretation.Flexiv_peak: The joint3 desired +86.0475 rad/s contains a large existing prior-cache-minus-actual gap plus a smaller same-joint new-IK increment; joint5 also has a substantial IK increment and tracking gap. Saved finite-pose IK residual remains small, while instantaneous FF twist mapping is poor, ctrl-range clipping is recorded on joint3/joint5, and real archived joint rates also exceed the cited limits.
interpretation.branch_boundary: No new branch or global IK search was performed. A finite change between consecutive cached IK solutions is observed; this is insufficient to prove a topological branch switch. A cached prior solution and actual state can diverge under servo dynamics, but these four samples do not isolate the dynamical cause.
interpretation.rate_boundary: The sole fixed regularized bounded local fit improves the large translational mismatch at peaks but does not exactly reproduce the requested six-dimensional twist. Optimizer success means numerical termination of the specified surrogate; it is neither a global infeasibility proof nor evidence that a projected controller would succeed.
interpretation.actual_speed_boundary: Real rate exceedance is read from all 650 saved pre-control native_qvel samples, separate from desired FF rates. Counts are sample counts and do not establish total exceedance duration or peaks between sampled controls.
interpretation.next_design_evidence: Any later controller proposal needs explicit joint-rate/position handling and a bounded command-to-actual tracking contract. This diagnosis implements no controller and authorizes no native regression or pilot.
interpretation.scope_unchanged: Official velocity limits are an additional diagnostic reference, not retrospective modifications to the original five physics gates or F-tier acceptance.
unconstrained_claims_avoided: No proof of a unique cause or global unreachability
